function: Learns UAV trajectory and power split among sensing and user beams (with user scheduling) to minimize AoI; beam directions come from Kalman filter and RZF (p. 5-7).
system: UAV with 4x4 UPA serving K=6 single-antenna ground users, downlink with superimposed sensing waveform, free-space LoS channel, 2 GHz; no RIS (p. 3, 9).
method: Soft actor-critic deep RL (two-layer fully connected actor, twin critics), trained online in simulation; A2C is the learned baseline (p. 7-9).
data_channel: Custom simulator: free-space Friis path loss with LoS steering vectors; 100 random user layouts, perturbed target path; no 3GPP model, dataset, or measurement (p. 3-4, 8-9).
test_conditions: Same simulator for training and testing, 100 Monte Carlo episodes; sweeps of SINR threshold, accuracy threshold, array size, and K, with training curves per setting (p. 9-12).
baselines: Learned: A2C on the same MDP. Non-learned: SAGS (single-user AoI-greedy scheduling) and KF-RAND (random waypoint and user logits around Kalman forecast) (p. 9).
metrics: Average AoI (main), episode return, radar detection SNR, user SINR, UAV trajectories, EIRP footprints (p. 9-12).
complexity: Analytical orders only: inference O(Fpi+K+M^3) per slot, training per episode O(NM^3+(N/Iupd)JD(Fpi+2FQ)); no measured runtime (p. 8).
q1_support: p. 3: "follows a free-space path loss model described by the Friis transmission equation" - custom LoS channel (Eq. 9, p. 4); no 3GPP model, DeepMIMO, or measured data.
q2_support: p. 9: "compare the convergence performance of the proposed SAC algorithm and the A2C baseline under different system parameters" - separate training per setting; no test on conditions unseen in training is stated.
q3_support: p. 9: "Single-User AoI-Greedy Scheduling (SAGS)" (non-learned); p. 10: "A2C performs moderately well but consistently lags behind SAC" (learned baseline, compared on average AoI).
q4_support: p. 8: "resulting in a per-slot inference complexity of O" - Complexity Analysis derives inference and training orders; no FLOPs or runtime measured.
q5_support: p. 8: "100 distinct random user layouts using seeds ranging from 100 to 199" - own simulator; no code or data link and no public dataset.
notes: Included, area 6 rather than 5: UAV (aerial) ISAC link where the agent learns power/beam resource control jointly with trajectory (aerial power and beam control is physical layer; 6 precedes 5 in the tie-break). Beam directions are Kalman/RZF, not learned. A2C (Mnih 2016, same state/action/reward) counted as the standard learned baseline; reviewer please confirm. Fig. 7 asymmetric layout is not stated as unseen in training, so q2=0.
